observations: Photo 0 shows a red and black sofa with a curved backrest, red seat cushion, and black armrests. Two pillows are placed on it: one pink and one dark with a graphic design.

Photo 1 shows the same sofa from a side angle, revealing its full form. The sofa has a black base and legs, with a red seat and black armrests. The material appears to be faux leather or vinyl, with visible stitching.
The sofa has a modern, compact design, likely a 2-seater or small loveseat.
No brand or model is visible on the sofa in either photo.
The seller's text claims it is 'bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.' This is not verifiable from the photos.
